synopsis: The corpus positions MATLAB/Simulink with the Offroad Autonomy Library and RoadRunner as a complete or near-complete commercial simulation platform, licensed annually or perpetually per product [f8346, f8373, f15877]. Shipped R2026b examples cover an autonomous excavator, a backhoe loading a truck and an open-pit haul truck; Volvo CE also built a human-in-the-loop excavator simulator on the MathWorks platform [f15878, f15879]. An expert-proposed middle-cost chain combines MATLAB/Simulink, RoadRunner, Unreal and sensor toolboxes with Mevea or AGX Dynamics through FMI for terrain, hydraulics and machine variants [f16162]. Integration evidence includes MAVS in February 2024 and MATLAB APIs for Prescan; RoadRunner Scenario and replay workflows also list MATLAB interfaces, although RoadRunner itself does not require MATLAB or Simulink [f4163, f8458, f9195, f9252, f8385]. Public platform pricing is quote-only: an unofficial January 2024 list gives MATLAB prices of 980 annually or 3,920 perpetually, presumed US dollars and indicative only, rather than a confirmed platform budget [f15880, f8387, f16142].
